reviews.title: Scammers
reviews.text: I used ReceiptJar consistently for YEARS and spent a huge amount of time scanning receipts. I successfully redeemed a $50 Amazon gift card and a $20 gift card in the past, so I had no reason to believe I was doing something wrong. Recently, I reached another $20 redemption and requested it. Instead of receiving my reward, my redemption was rejected and my entire account was suspended. The explanation? “Receipt Diving - Occasional.” What makes absolutely no sense to me is that I submitted receipts from my own purchases and, occasionally, receipts that members of my family gave me after they went shopping. Receipts don’t necessarily have the purchaser’s name on them, so I don’t understand how ReceiptJar decided that this was “receipt diving.” I was never clearly told which receipts supposedly violated the rules, what I specifically did wrong, or given any evidence explaining the decision. After YEARS of spending my time scanning receipts, this is extremely frustrating. Yes, I received two gift cards previously, but losing access to my account and having another $20 redemption rejected after putting in years of effort is ridiculous. If you are going to spend your time scanning receipts for this app, make sure you fully understand their rules before investing years of your time into it.

reviews.title: Use Fetch instead
reviews.text: I used receipt jar for a couple of years. I read another reviewer that had same thing happen to them. We have 2 adult kids and if my husband buys something at the grocery store or at a fast food place and I buy my own meal later or my kids do and u scan the receipts they flag ur account and disable your account. I was about to collect $10 In Rewards and that happened. What a scam!They are not as good as fetch. Smaller rewards for receipts submitted and smaller amount of points awarded for receipts. And after all that (you giving THEM your information on what you are buying- you are doing THEM a favor) they suspend your account. Deleted the app after I got that suspension email and will stick with FETCH! Would NOT recommend!!
